_about: Known shipped files that still hold a trust anchor for a distrusted key, each decided by the maintainer with its reason and an end. trust_store.py accepts a finding only for this exact file content (sha256), this key and while the bundled agent runtime is this version (agent_runtime.json); an exception for another runtime version has expired and fails the check until it is removed. Never add one for Angelo's own code or bundled Python.
